notes.title: Version Update 0.9.2
notes.notes:
+ New Full-featured Workshop

Aincrad Workshp has 5 main sections, you can browse, search, subscribe, download, manage and create workshop items easily.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/aa9eeba4da120111721481e4266c3e923b4018db.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/103e4a3374a54ee9884901526115a57c63d4242c.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/b2919fa82778cd65504efdc4809cc8efcc0999ec.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/efee4d9f8196e37a86b3217fa3a5d643c593b8af.png

+ New "Image Set" Workshop Item Type

You could craft and subscribe this new "Image Set" items in the workshop, and make use of them via the image pick up dialog from:

    Image Widget
    GGO Widget
    Information panel of launcher menus

BMP, GIF, ICO, JPG, PNG formats are supported.

+ New Achievements

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/deb860c27eef11225b57ac8efce84f8157ea9a88.png

+ New option for touch gesture

Turn on or off the "Two fingers sliding down" gesture for touch devices, you could find this switch via Preference - General - Enable Touch Gesture.

+ Add Spanish translation

Many thanks to the translation work by MoonAntonio .
You will find the translation sources for SAO Utils in our Locale Repository 

+ Other Updates

    Fix url file's icons are not displayed correctly in "Real Folder" launcher menu
    Fix cannot run some programs via launcher menu
    Fix some system cannot load Web Browser Engine plug-in
    Fix Steam keep "In App" status even if SAO Utils already exited
    Fix Steam inject overlays into apps launched by SAO Utils

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.1
notes.notes:
+ Add Steam features switch option
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/ff5d688f922b82992f6731f1399d8282490cbe50.png
Disable it will

    Remove associations to Steam, stop in-game time counting
    Prevent killing SAO Utils when Steam exit
    HP-Bar no more display Steam level
    Unable to download or upload workshop items


+ Add CN, EN, JA chat channels
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/83b2f1889afd50dedac75241bb40393aaa0b11ed.png

+ Update Traditional Chinese translation
Many thanks to the translation work by zhtw .
You will find the translation sources for SAO Utils from our Locale Repository .

+ Fix "Disable mouse gesture in fullscreen mode" does not work properly
Someone claim that they can't use mouse gesture to call out the launcher after checking "Disable mouse gesture in fullscreen mode" option.
That's really a bug issued by NVIDIA GeForce Experience :P

+ Bangumi animation data updated (2018 Spring)
Many thanks to the update work by TimeLord.
